notes: FORM-CHARACTERISATION READ — the first 2014 filing of this chunk, and the map for the other 45 filings of the cycle. THE 2014 FORM: printed title '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES' (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), with a vertical sidebar reading 'COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES' — note this is a BROADER title than the 2012 blank's 'FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', and it is the reason the module's removed body-keyword fallback false-positived on 'school board'. Variant legacy_colAB, 4 pages, shape cover / SUMMARY PAGE / SCHEDULE A / SCHEDULE B. THE SUMMARY PAGE WAS LOCATED BY ITS PRINTED HEADING 'SUMMARY PAGE (NOTE: Complete this page after filling out Schedule A and Schedule B)' and sits at p2 here; it prints Column A 'Total this Period' and Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' against lines 1-7 exactly as the legacy family does. SCHEDULES: 'SCHEDULE A — ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' and 'SCHEDULE B — ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE', both '(Attach additional pages if needed)'. COLUMNS: Schedule A is Date / Name of Contributor / 'Address, City & Zip' / Amount; Schedule B is Date / 'Purchased From/Source' / 'Address, City & Zip' / Amount. CONFIRMED FOR THE WAVE: Schedule B DOES print its own payee heading in 2014 ('Purchased From/Source'), which fixes the 2012 defect where Schedule B reused 'Name of Contributor' — but there is STILL NO PURPOSE COLUMN anywhere on the 2014 Schedule B, so `purpose` remains honestly blank for 2014 expenditure rows. GRID: 17 printed per-column underline rules on each schedule, text ABOVE its rule, so 17 usable data rows with row 1 extrapolated one pitch up. EACH SCHEDULE PRINTS ITS OWN TWO FOOTER ANCHORS: 'Subtotal for this page $ ___' and 'Total Contributions/Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A/B pages) $ ___' — so with the cover's Column A there are THREE printed anchors per side, and on this filing all three agree to the cent on both sides. FOLIATION: the 2014 form prints a 'Page __ of __ / Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name / Date of Report' box on every sheet AFTER the cover, and this filer completed all three boxes — 1 of 3 (summary), 2 of 3 (Schedule A), 3 of 3 (Schedule B), each stamped 'Buhman' and '10-27-14'. FOLIATION THEREFORE EXCLUDES THE COVER on this filing, matching Addendum A §A4's Poulson observation; it still must never be used to locate a page. PAGE-FACE candidate 'Jeffrey R. Buhman' (Republican), office written 'Utah County Attorney', agreeing with the channel's 'County Attorney'; index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed and dated 10-27-14; clerk's date stamp 'OCT 27 AM 9:00'. NOT A MULTI-REPORT BUNDLE — this is a single 4-page report; the Buhman 2014 original+amendment bundle cited in the brief is a DIFFERENT file, and nothing on these four pages carries a second report. WHAT '_Redacted' ACTUALLY COVERS HERE (a source property worth carrying forward): the county's redaction bar blacks out the COVER's own 'Street Address / City / State / Zip Code' row — the CANDIDATE's home address — and NOTHING ELSE. The donor's address block on Schedule A and both vendors' address blocks on Schedule B are published fully in the clear. So on this filing an empty address cell would be the FILER leaving it empty, never the county redacting it; the county's redaction touched only p1.
